request.style: English, solemn female solo voice, organ, harp, strings, 80 BPM, hymn
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Abraham took another wife
Whose name was Keturah
She bore him Zimran first
Jokshan and Medan there

[Verse]
Midian and Ishbak too
And Shuah round the hearth
Six sons by Keturah born
In the ancient earth

[Verse]
Abraham gave everything
To Isaac as his heir
But to the sons of concubines
Gifts he did not spare

[Verse]
While he was still alive
He sent them far away
From Isaac and his son
To the land of the day

[Verse]
He breathed his last and died
Old and satisfied with life
Gathered to his people
In the cave of his life

[Outro]
Sent eastward to the land
